name: gmail-sendas
description: Thin Gmail MCP for sendAs aliases, in-thread reply_as, and inbound/outbound attachments. Complements stock Gmail MCP — do not use this plugin for inbox search, labels, or triage.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.title: Google OAuth client ID
GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID from Google Cloud Console (Desktop or Web client). Never commit this value.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Google OAuth client secret
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret from Google Cloud Console. Set in Plugins → Configure only.

GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN.title: Google OAuth refresh token
GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Offline refresh token for the Workspace user who owns the sendAs aliases. Generate once with scripts/oauth-setup.js; paste here. Never commit.
